english.title: Fail to comply with a notice issued by an appropriate authority / a regulator / an exemption registration authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a notice under regulation 60(1) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010 issued by

(A)_[an appropriate authority]_
(B)_[a regulator]_
(C)_[an exemption registration authority]_

on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE OF ISSUE OF THE NOTICE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 38(4)(a) and 39(3) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit or Prosecutions:
None.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
